deviations.description: The initial synthetic-memory-gate invocation stopped after all 72 live API sequences and their evaluations completed.
deviations.reason: The tagged benchmark imported src.razor.memory_bank, but the temporary tagged checkout root was not present on Python's module search path, producing ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'src'.
deviations.expectedEffect: No effect on the 72 completed live API records, model outputs, evaluation reports, or aggregate live-model summary. The synthetic proxy track is separate from live-model evidence.
deviations.correctiveAction: Executed only the unchanged tagged synthetic benchmark with PYTHONPATH set to the temporary tagged checkout root, then generated the missing synthetic record and run manifest.
